\title{Learned Cardinality Estimation for Join Queries}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
We study learned cardinality estimation for multi-way join queries.
\end{abstract}

\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:intro}
Cardinality estimation is the \emph{Achilles heel} of query optimizers~\cite{leis2015}.
Errors grow exponentially with the number of joins (see Section~\ref{sec:method}).
We reduce the error by 50\% on JOB.
